figurative_meaning_en: To intimidate or scare someone by glaring menacingly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার চোখ রাঙিয়ে শিশুটিকে ভয় দেখাল।
বস চোখ রাঙানোর মাধ্যমে কর্মীদের চুপ করিয়ে দিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He scared the child by glaring at him with reddened eyes.
The boss silenced the workers by giving them a menacing glare.
note: This idiom evokes traditional expressions of anger or dominance in Bengali folklore and daily interactions.
